description: This is a configuration module for a Flask-based web application that manages system settings via environment variables. It defines a Settings dataclass with attributes for database connection details, JWT security parameters, upload configurations, and CORS origins, and provides a factory method to instantiate Settings from environment variables.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Immutable configuration holder for the Flask API, created from environment variables.

methods.name: "Settings" from_env()
methods.description: Creates a Settings instance by fetching configuration values from environment variables, raising an error if required variables are missing.

methods.name: str|None _get_env(name: str, default: str | None = None)
